page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a running head above it and a gathering signature at the foot right. Headings are set in italic and in capitals. A decorative rule separates the end of the Architecture section from "DE ETHICA." Page number at the head right.

main_text.l: Horti & piscinæ, garten vnd fischteiche. Horti pen-
siles sunt, qui de fenestris appenduntur. Hortos cir-
cundant sepes structiles, vel vivæ seu naturales ex ru-
bis & spinis.
Machina, ein rüstzeug / est pars Architecturæ sub-
veniens desperatis actionibus, qua etiam contra na-
turam agere licet.
Cùm onera machinis trahuntur, aut ad altitudi-
nem sublata deponuntur: Cujus species fere sunt:
Fistuca, ein schlegel/ so man auff zeucht vnd laßt wieder herab fallen / daß
die pfäle in den boden gehen/ Trochlea, ein welle vber die ein seil oder kette gehet
an einem zug / Tympanum, ein zugrad/ ein kranich/
Succula, ein zugwahl/ die man mit stangen vmbtrei-
bet / Vectis, ein stang.
Lecturus præcepta prolixiora videat Vitruvium,
Grapaldum & alios.
Hactenus expofita est Architectura: sequi-
tur Ethica.
DE ETHICA.
ETHICA, die tugentkunst / est ars secun-
dum virtutem vivendi: Cujus Subjectum
est Virtus.
Est habitus animi in mediocritate consistens. Cu-
jus species sunt quatuor:
Justitia, Fortitudo, Pruden-
tia, Temperantia.

page.notes: Black letter (German) words are marked with bl. Doubtful: the printed "expofita" (for exposita) is kept as printed, a probable printing error. "fi!chteiche" in the first paragraph is read as "fischteiche". The "ein rüstzeug" and "tugentkunst" lines are read from a small scan and may contain minor errors. The drop cap E of "Ethica" is joined to the word. The decorative rule above DE ETHICA is not text.
